observations: Three photos show a grey moving head stage light on a wooden table.
The light has a large lens at the top, a rotating head, and a base with control panel and ports.
The brand 'BEAM' is visible in red text on a black oval sticker on the front of the head in all photos.
The model '300' is also visible in red text on the same sticker in photos 0 and 2.
The word 'EXCELLENCE' is printed in white on the front of the base in all photos.
The light appears to be in used condition with some minor scuffs and dust.
No power cord, remote, or accessories are visible in any photo.
The control panel at the base shows some buttons and a small display, but no labels or text are legible.

claims.evidence: The brand 'BEAM' and model '300' are clearly visible on the front of the light in photos 0 and 2. The '300w' is not visible but is a common model designation for this type of light; the seller's claim is plausible and consistent with the visual evidence.

risks.risk: The light may not be functional or may have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the light turning on, rotating, and changing colors, or a photo of the power cord and plug.

risks.risk: The light may be missing accessories such as the power cord, remote, or mounting hardware.
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the light.

risks.risk: The light may have electrical or mechanical issues not visible in still photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the light operating under different voltage or a close-up of the internal components.

proof_requests: Video of the light turning on and rotating.
Photo of the power cord and plug.
Photo of all included accessories (remote, cables, etc.).
Close-up of the control panel and any labels or serial numbers.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
